parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: Filters by label key and value. Separate multiple labels with commas (,).

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The display mode. Valid values: tree or list.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: desc or asc.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to query. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: ParentQuotaId
parameters.description:
Filters by ParentQuotaId:

- Not specified: lists all quotas under the tenant, including root quotas and child quotas.

- Empty string: lists all root quotas.

- Non-empty string: lists all child quotas of the specified ParentQuotaId.

parameters.name: QuotaIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated QuotaIds for filtering. Only exact match is supported. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified at a time.

parameters.name: QuotaName
parameters.description: Filters by QuotaName. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type of the quota (Lingjun/ECS/ACS). Default value: ECS.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- QuotaName

- Status

- CPU

- Memory

- GPU

- GmtCreatedTime

- GmtModifiedTime

parameters.name: Statuses
parameters.description: Comma-separated quota statuses for filtering. Only exact match is supported.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display details. Valid values:
- true: Display details.
- false: Do not display details.

parameters.name: WorkspaceIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated WorkspaceIds for filtering. Only exact match is supported. A maximum of 10 IDs can be specified at a time.

parameters.name: WorkspaceName
parameters.description: The name of the associated workspace.
